name: Forgent Power Solutions, Inc.
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted
f_subtype_basis: sum of the last 2 fiscal years (the median window)

overrides_applied.source: Forgent Power Solutions FY2026 10-K (filed 2026-09-15, period ended 2026-06-30), MD&A non-GAAP reconciliation 'Adjusted Diluted EPS': adjusted diluted weighted average shares outstanding 304,699 (in thousands) = diluted weighted average shares 243,802 + assumed exchange of Class B common stock 60,897 + dilutive effect of RSUs 270 (all in thousands)
overrides_applied.reason: Up-C IPO structure (Feb 2026): the predecessor was an LLC, so no diluted share count is filed for FY2025 and the GAAP diluted count filed for FY2026 (243,802,000) covers only the post-IPO period Feb 6 - Jun 30, 2026 and excludes the exchangeable Class B / Opco interests. The 10-K's own Adjusted Diluted EPS reconciliation rebuilds the full-period diluted count assuming exchange of all Class B from the beginning of the earliest period presented: 243,802,000 GAAP diluted + 60,897,000 assumed Class B exchange + 270,000 dilutive RSUs = 304,699,000. Consolidated OCF/capex/SBC in the engine are 100% of Opco, so this is the matching denominator. Cross-check: shares outstanding at Jun 30, 2026 per the same 10-K balance sheet are 259,971,169 Class A + 44,457,720 Class B = 304,428,889, within 0.1% of the weighted figure.

fragility_flags: BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
THIN_HISTORY: only 2 fiscal years of data

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Forgent Power Solutions FY2026 10-K (filed 2026-09-15, period ended 2026-06-30), MD&A non-GAAP reconciliation 'Adjusted Diluted EPS': adjusted diluted weighted average shares outstanding 304,699 (in thousands) = diluted weighted average shares 243,802 + assumed exchange of Class B common stock 60,897 + dilutive effect of RSUs 270 (all in thousands)); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
note: No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone. If the latest year alone is positive, that is a flag to investigate, not a pass. F sub-type: no cash generation (OCF - capex is not positive).

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
